title: Part Nine: People Under Control Without Citizenship

sections.brief: Who is counted (PCBS 5.56m end-2025 vs Israel ~10m; Freedom House excludes WB 22/Gaza 2); two legal systems (ACRI 24 vs 96 hours; 99.74% conviction 2010; emergency regulations renewal failed 6 Jun 2022, passed 24 Jan 2023 to 15 Feb 2028; Smotrich powers; 30 Mar 2026 death-penalty law); settler series 1972-2025; Area C permits; East Jerusalem residency (362,000; municipal vote only; 2024 election), HaMoked revocations 1967-2022 (14,808; peak 4,577 in 2008), citizenship applications (Reuters 2017); who votes (Mas'ha/Elkana; PA elections postponed 10 Oct 2026 to 11 Sep 2027); ICJ 2024, apartheid reports, Israel's position. Figures: time; stats; compare

Forms of control 1967-2026 (Gaza-Jericho 1994; exit permits 1991, registry freeze 2000, Erez 500,000/month 2000 vs 3,000 permits 2013; disengagement and retained controls; blockade; medical permits 90%->62%); legal argument (Al-Bassiouni 2008; ICJ 2024 functional test; ICJ Oct 2025 basic needs, Israel rejects); war and population (74,382 killed to 12 Oct 2026; PCBS 2.13m, -254,000; shelter 94%); who governs as of Oct 2026 (64% behind Yellow Line, no ISF, Hamas body dissolved, Shaath committee, Board of Peace, Rafah clearance, elections postponed). Figures: time; stats

US territories (2020 census 3.6m; no presidential vote; nonvoting delegates; Insular Cases, Gorsuch, cert denied 17 Oct 2022 in American Samoa citizenship case); Iraq occupation (UNSC 1483, detention peak 26,000 Nov 2007, Bucca closure 2009); Guantanamo (15, 6 uncharged) and ICE detention (68,289) linked to us4/us6; the unequal comparison stated plainly (a third vs about 1 per cent; military vs civil law; duration).
